001
002package gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.item.node;
003
004import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.util.ObjectUtils;
005
006import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.Nullable;
007
008/**
009 * A common base class for node item implementations.
010 */
011public abstract class AbstractNodeItem implements INodeItem {
012
013  /**
014   * Generates a string signature for this node item in the format:
015   * {@code type\u2ABBlocation_metapath\u2ABC} or
016   * {@code type\u2ABBlocation_metapath\u2ABC(value)} where:
017   * <ul>
018   * <li>type: The node type signature
019   * <li>location_metapath: A Metapath for the node's location in the document
020   * <li>value: Optional value signature if a value is present
021   * </ul>
022   * The special characters \u2ABB and \u2ABC are used as delimiters to clearly
023   * separate the type from the location Metapath expression.
024   *
025   * @return the string signature of this node item
026   */
027  @SuppressWarnings("checkstyle:AvoidEscapedUnicodeCharacters")
028  @Override
029  public final String toSignature() {
030    StringBuilder builder = new StringBuilder()
031        .append(getType().toSignature())
032        .append('\u2ABB')
033        .append(getMetapath())
034        .append('\u2ABC');
035    String value = getValueSignature();
036    if (value != null) {
037      builder.append('(')
038          .append(value)
039          .append(')');
040    }
041    return ObjectUtils.notNull(builder.toString());
042  }
043
044  /**
045   * Get the signature of this node's value.
046   *
047   * @return the value's signature or {@code null} if the node has no value
048   */
049  @Nullable
050  protected abstract String getValueSignature();
051
052  @Override
053  public final String toString() {
054    return toSignature();
055  }
056}
